stops.name: Herreninsel
stops.detail: Herreninsel (German pronunciation: [ˈhɛʁənˌʔɪnzl̩] ; old name: Herrenwörth) is a 238 hectare island in Bavaria's largest lake, Chiemsee. It is the biggest of the lake's three main islands, Fraueninsel and Krautinsel joining it to form the municipality of Chiemsee.
